title: LocalFlow V2 M09 Adversarial Corpus
purpose: Machine-readable normative adversarial test specifications for local reproduction/remediation, not an executable runner and not a test-results report.
execution_boundary: No case, native probe, mutation or performance benchmark was run during this read-only GPT audit.

fixture_protocol.identities: A/B/job_A/example_A are fixture aliases. Mint real IDs using the current approved factory, record the alias map, and never fabricate legacy job IDs.
fixture_protocol.stores: Use per-case temporary stores and sandbox HOME/config. Never open Daniel’s real History or mutate his installed app.

audio.independent_oracle: Verify header/sample/hash using an independent parser or struct-built fixture; PCM16 is an in-memory replay derivative, never the original.

fixture_protocol.time: Inject/record UTC instants and an IANA zone separately; do not substitute now for missing provenance.
fixture_protocol.threading: Use threading.Event/Barrier or equivalent latches with explicit completion logs. Sleeps alone are not a race oracle. Track every admitted task.
fixture_protocol.native: Actual AppKit construction/mutation on main; pump the real run loop or a main-drained queue. Inline callAfter is allowed only as an isolated negative dispatch control intercepted before AppKit mutation.
fixture_protocol.privacy: Synthetic diagnostics/audio/text only. No real screenshots, event logs, selected text or app-use metadata in Git.
fixture_protocol.authority: Use actual Hub actions for button tests; service/coordinator direct-call tests are separate controls, not substitutes.

result_protocol.audit_status_rule: Every authored case, relation and mutation remains NOT_RUN. Local results go in a separate versioned results file; preserve this corpus unchanged.
result_protocol.independence: Expected identities/states/substrings/event order must come from fixture definitions, not from production query outputs.
result_protocol.mutation_kill: Control passes, mutation is proven applied, intended oracle fails for the intended reason; timeout, syntax/import/harness errors and unrelated failures are not kills.
result_protocol.benchmark_gate: Work validity first, then timing. Missing/empty/no-op required workload cannot qualify.
result_protocol.timeout: Record timeout as unknown/unfinished when work may commit later; do not call it a cancelled write.

metamorphic_relations.name: Newer query wins
metamorphic_relations.transformation: Permute completion timing while preserving admitted query order.
metamorphic_relations.invariant: Only the newest authorized generation may alter current data/detail/error/loading.

metamorphic_relations.name: Selection binding
metamorphic_relations.transformation: Change selected/rendered identity during outstanding detail/action work.
metamorphic_relations.invariant: Authority can be rejected; it cannot migrate to a different record.

metamorphic_relations.name: Delete monotonicity
metamorphic_relations.invariant: Renderable/replayable/copyable private payload can only decrease after revocation.

metamorphic_relations.name: Listening isolation
metamorphic_relations.transformation: Replay a different example or fail playback.
metamorphic_relations.invariant: Verbatim authorization for the selected example never increases without its own valid initiation.

metamorphic_relations.name: Retry idempotence
metamorphic_relations.transformation: Duplicate delivery while the same retry claim is active.
metamorphic_relations.invariant: No extra admitted worker attempt or insertion for that in-flight retry intent.

metamorphic_relations.name: Repaste intent identity
metamorphic_relations.transformation: Compare duplicate delivery of one UI token with two fresh explicit tokens.
metamorphic_relations.invariant: Duplicate delivery is not duplicated; fresh user intent is not collapsed by job identity.

metamorphic_relations.name: Retention cannot manufacture lineage
metamorphic_relations.transformation: Remove one retained artifact without changing other identities.
metamorphic_relations.invariant: The missing stage becomes unavailable; it never borrows another stage’s text.

metamorphic_relations.name: Main-thread invariant
metamorphic_relations.transformation: Change query/action completion thread and timing.
metamorphic_relations.invariant: Every AppKit mutation remains on main; pure-state callbacks alone prove nothing native.

metamorphic_relations.name: Pin/review-lease separation
metamorphic_relations.transformation: Toggle user pin while leaving annotations unchanged.
metamorphic_relations.invariant: Review-retention lease is neither revoked nor mislabeled as user pin.

metamorphic_relations.name: Legacy search identity
metamorphic_relations.transformation: Change which half of the same pair matches.
metamorphic_relations.invariant: Logical row identity and retained full pair remain stable.

metamorphic_relations.name: Filename-independent diagnostics
metamorphic_relations.transformation: Rename/reorder rotated filenames without changing events.
metamorphic_relations.invariant: Stream-aware event order and filtered last-N identities remain invariant.

metamorphic_relations.name: Redaction extension safety
metamorphic_relations.transformation: Add arbitrary unknown/nested fields to an event.
metamorphic_relations.invariant: No added payload becomes exportable; known valid content-free fields remain valid.

metamorphic_relations.name: Lifecycle restriction monotonicity
metamorphic_relations.transformation: Interleave exclusion toggles and annotation operations with terminal restrictions.
metamorphic_relations.invariant: No action erases quarantine/expiry/deletion or implicitly restores user exclusion.

metamorphic_relations.name: Benchmark work sensitivity
metamorphic_relations.transformation: Delete mandatory work or move it outside the timed boundary.
metamorphic_relations.invariant: Validity fails independently of a faster elapsed time.
